note: BH-9073 (BH-9067.1). The wake gate mode of review-rescue (): off (no take, the lane runs as before), shadow (take, log what on would do, the lane always runs) or on (a scheduled tick with no ring exits 0 before any D1 read (scope fleet: rings only, the backstop ring of catalog/lane-calendar.d/review-rescue.tsv)). Settings row lib.lane-wake-gate.mode_review_rescue; it wins over lib.lane-wake-gate.mode_default. Any other word is ignored and named once per LWG_FAIL_LOG_EVERY_S in logs/lane-wake-gate.log. The knob name is the mode_knob of , which lwg_mode in bin/lib/lane-wake-gate.sh reads; never read from the env.
